title: Gate delivery on deterministic planning health
description: Add an explainable planning assessment before review and shipping. A score summarizes quality, but zero named blockers is independently required. Non-goals: AI-judged prose quality, replacing behavior verification, or letting a high average waive a missing production or rollback plan.

behaviors.title: Evaluate planning health deterministically
behaviors.trigger: A builder records or reads an issue planning profile
behaviors.expected: Loopbreaker returns a stable 0-100 score, five dimension scores, named hard blockers, recommendations, and an explicit ready flag
behaviors.verify: Run the evaluator repeatedly against healthy and incomplete fixtures and observe identical scores plus exact blocker codes

behaviors.title: Apply planning readiness before review and shipping
behaviors.trigger: An issue has missing planning blockers or a planning score below threshold
behaviors.expected: Pass one is rejected and shipping remains held by planning even when execution evidence is otherwise complete; a healthy plan releases only the planning gate
behaviors.verify: Exercise an incomplete plan through the domain API, then repair it and observe the gate move from planning to verification without prematurely shipping

behaviors.title: Expose ergonomic planning tools to builders and agents
behaviors.trigger: A builder uses the CLI or an agent uses MCP
behaviors.expected: Both surfaces can record a partial plan and read compact planning health with actionable blocker details
behaviors.verify: Run the built CLI against a JSON plan and complete a real MCP handshake that discovers and calls both planning tools

behaviors.title: Visualize planning health in the workflow graph
behaviors.trigger: A builder opens an issue with any planning state
behaviors.expected: The live graph shows planning score, readiness, dimensions, and blockers upstream of behavior verification and the terminal ship decision
behaviors.verify: Open healthy and blocked issues in a real browser and inspect the accessible planning node and ordered gate state

behaviors.title: Preserve existing review and migration semantics
behaviors.trigger: An existing database migrates or a planned issue completes review and verification
behaviors.expected: Existing data migrates safely, the two-plus-one review limit remains intact, and a healthy fully verified issue still reaches ship
behaviors.verify: Run the complete repository suite, migration fixture, package check, and one live healthy issue from import through ship

planning.outcome: Builders and agents can tell whether an issue is sufficiently planned before implementation, review, or shipment.
planning.appetite: One focused implementation slice with schema migration, CLI, MCP, graph, and live proof.
non_goals: Allowing score averages to waive hard blockers

work_units.title: Persist and score planning profiles
work_units.done_when: Health is deterministic and both review and shipping consult it.

work_units.title: Add CLI and MCP planning tools
work_units.done_when: Builders and agents receive compact TOON health output.

work_units.title: Render planning readiness upstream of delivery
work_units.done_when: The browser exposes score, dimensions, blockers, and gate order.

proofs.method: Exercise the persisted evaluator through domain tests and built CLI.
Drive planning hold, verification hold, and ship in one real database.
Call both planning tools through a real MCP client/server handshake.
Inspect healthy and blocked planning nodes with agent-browser.
Run migration, bounded-review, full verification, and package checks.

planning.production_wiring: The SQLite-backed domain evaluator feeds substrate, pass admission, shipping, CLI, MCP, HTTP, WebSocket refresh, and React Flow graph construction.
planning.rollback: Remove planning enforcement from pass admission and shipping while retaining stored profiles; the existing verification gate remains intact.
planning.migration: Create planning_profiles idempotently; existing issues become explicitly planning-blocked until a profile is recorded.

risks.risk: A scalar score hides a critical omission.
risks.mitigation: Named hard blockers are conjunctive and cannot be averaged away.
Missing profiles are explicitly blocked rather than silently grandfathered.
